page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 48 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, paired with 186.0 GB of RAM, yielding approximately 3.88 GB of memory per core. The server includes two NVIDIA Turing T4 GPUs providing a total of 32 GB of VRAM. It does not include local storage, and network connectivity is rated at a baseline of 15 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is weak, with stress-ng single-core scores at 1104.08 and single-threaded gzip compression rated as poor at 19.19 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-core operations perform at an average level, as demonstrated by a stress-ng multi-core score of 35393.62 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 149.01 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth is also average, measuring 98.26 GB/sec for large block read-only operations and 44.08 GB/sec for large block write operations.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the server delivers dedicated CPU resources and dual GPU accelerators, making it a viable option for workloads that can leverage parallel processing to offset the weaker single-core performance. The lack of local storage requires external storage attachments, which is a key architectural tradeoff. This configuration is suited for GPU-accelerated workloads, multi-threaded data processing, static web serving, and Redis-based caching operations.
